title: docs(skills): name the ctx.email.send and ctx.activity.append body doors in the data-hooks reference
body:
security#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cx5nHfga3Hm9BzikGw

Filed by the security lane as the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #32966. Priority and lane belong to triage.

Blocked-by: #32966

## Why

PR #32966 (step 1 of ruling 6796076408 on #32004) gives a hook, action or job body two platform doors, each behind its own capability:

- `ctx.email.send(input)` (`email.send`), for action and job bodies only. A hook body cannot send mail ([ruling](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/32004#issuecomment-6843314411)): the grant is refused at parse and at bind, and mail on a record change goes through an action, a job or a flow.
- `ctx.activity.append(input)` (`activity.append`), which adds an entry to a record's activity timeline. The entry commits or rolls back with the write that runs the body.

`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` does not yet name either door. Neither its `ctx` surface table nor "Capabilities — the complete list" mentions them.

## Acceptance

- The `ctx` table and the capability list name both doors, with the hook-body rule for `email.send` stated once.
- The text matches the published schema descriptions in `@objectstack/spec` (`BodyMailSendInputSchema`, `BodyActivityAppendInputSchema`) and `content/docs` (`hook-bodies.mdx`, `email-service.mdx`).
- `skills/**` line ratchet holds: net growth is paid for by deleting content in the same file (`check:skill-line-ratchet`). Add an `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset.
- `check:skill-docs` and `check:skill-refs` stay current.
